snippet.title: Rockman 6: Shijou Saidai No Tatakai!! (PS1) - Full Playthrough (No Death)
snippet.description:
A full playthrough of the final Mega Man game for the NES. For this recording I used the Complete Works port for PS1 just like for previous games: it lets me to minimize the time spent in menus while choosing the weapons.

This game is one of the easiest of Mega Man series. I'm not saying anything bad about it, though. It is one of my favorite ones.

Well, I hope you like this playthrough. Enjoy.
